scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a few weeks ago, and I'm wondering if there's been any update. Could you please tell me if my application has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, I'd like to know the interest rate and the total costs associated with the loan if it has been approved.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The interest rate is 6.062%, and the total loan costs are $3,602.48.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. I'm glad to hear that my application has been approved. Could you also tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? And has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: There are no high-cost or negative amortization flags on your loan. The loan has not been sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear. Just one more thing, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: You were approved for a conventional first lien loan.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the information. I appreciate your help.

<Very Satisfied> - I felt exceptionally well served by the agent. They provided clear, honest, and detailed responses to all my questions, and I felt confident in their knowledge and professionalism.
